observed_prompts.text:
Create an 8-second opening shot of TABI enjoying a peaceful train journey through Tokyo at sunset. One continuous illustrated shot, designed to continue naturally into a longer video. Warm, detailed storybook illustration with clean, stable outlines, softly painted shading and gentle sunset colours. 

TABI is the same pink-lavender axolotl shown in the character reference, wearing the same purple headphones and green coat with leopard-patterned trim. Preserve his dark-brown eyes, rounded face, small mouth, tail and distinctive pink gills. Keep the gill shapes and attachment points consistent. His head, neck, collar and torso form one connected body. Preserve exactly two arms and two hands. 

A fictional vintage sightseeing carriage travelling through Tokyo. Two facing bench seats have peach-gold patterned upholstery, dark wooden frames and rounded wooden armrests. TABI sits on the left bench; the opposite bench remains empty. Warm walnut wall panels and wooden ceiling. A large rectangular window with rounded corners. Two brass wall lamps emit steady warm light. 

One small, fixed rectangular wooden table sits between the benches. On the table, there is exactly one white ceramic teacup on one matching white saucer, and one closed book resting next to it. Place them slightly left of the table’s centre. The cup and book stay stationary. No visible steam. No additional objects.

A locked wide shot from across the aisle, at TABI’s seated eye level. TABI occupies the left third. The table sits near the centre. The camera is fixed relative to the carriage: no pan, zoom, dolly, tilt, shake, cuts or focus changes.

An elevated railway view across Tokyo: layered rooftops, mid-rise buildings, and Tokyo Skytree in the distant skyline beneath a soft peach sunset. The train is already moving from the first frame. Scenery travels from screen right to screen left at a steady pace. 

TABI rests comfortably and quietly watches the passing view. His hands remain relaxed on his lap. Show gentle, visible breathing through a small, smooth rise and fall of his chest and shoulders. Include one relaxed blink. 

NATURAL PERFORMANCE REFINEMENT: Keep his mouth softly closed with the same small resting smile for the entire 8-second duration. There should be absolutely no mouth movement, lip twitching, talking, or opening of the mouth at any point, especially at the beginning of the clip. His expression is peaceful, still, and natural.

Quiet, even train ambience only. End with TABI still resting and breathing while the scenery continues moving.

Extend  Continue directly from the end of the selected clip as one uninterrupted shot.

Preserve the identical TABI: pink-lavender skin, dark-brown eyes, attached pink gills, purple headphones and green coat with leopard trim. Keep his face, proportions, connected neck and clothing consistent.

Maintain the locked camera, framing, wooden cabin, seats, table and single white cup and saucer. Preserve the current hand and cup positions until the requested action changes them.

TABI continues gentle visible breathing. The exterior continues moving right to left from its present position, at the same steady speed with natural parallax.

Clear cabin air. No floating dots, dust, glitter, sparks or drifting petals. No cuts, scenery reset, dialogue or music.

TABI gently shifts his eyes and makes a small natural head turn toward the passing view. His original dark-brown eyes remain visible, with one relaxed blink.

His shoulders stay relaxed and both hands remain on his lap. Keep the movement small, with his neck and collar connected. His mouth keeps its closed resting smile.

After the small turn, he quietly watches outside for the remainder of the clip, breathing gently. End while he is still watching.

TABI remains quietly seated, watching outside with gentle breathing and hands on his lap.

The existing scenery continues its current motion. As those buildings naturally leave through the left edge of the window, the following district gradually enters from the right:

A Ginza-inspired streetscape with elegant stone and glass façades, refined department stores, orderly shop windows and warm architectural lighting. Maintain the same illustrated style and sunset atmosphere.

Introduce the new architecture building by building. Preserve existing landmarks until they naturally leave the view. Maintain the same sunset, exposure, travel speed and depth relationships. The interior lighting stays steady.

End with the new district becoming established outside, while the train continues moving.

Extend  Continue directly from the end of the selected clip as one uninterrupted shot.

Preserve the identical TABI: pink-lavender skin, dark-brown eyes, attached pink gills, purple headphones and green coat with leopard trim. Keep his face, proportions, connected neck and clothing consistent.

Maintain the locked camera, framing, wooden cabin, seats, table and single white cup and saucer. Preserve the current hand and cup positions until the requested action changes them.

TABI continues gentle visible breathing. The exterior continues moving right to left from its present position, at the same steady speed with natural parallax.

Clear cabin air. No floating dots, dust, glitter, sparks or drifting petals. No cuts, scenery reset, dialogue or music.

Starting with the cup on its saucer and his hands on his lap, TABI glances down at the cup.

The hand nearest the table slowly reaches for the existing cup handle, grips it and lifts that same cup. His other hand gently supports it. Only his two existing arms move; the hands leave the lap as they reach.

The saucer remains empty and stationary on the table. Keep the cup rigid and upright. End with the cup held comfortably near his chest, below his mouth.

TABI remains quietly seated, watching outside with gentle breathing and hands on his lap.

The existing scenery continues its current motion. As those buildings naturally leave through the left edge of the window, the following district gradually enters from the right:

A Ginza-inspired streetscape with elegant stone and glass façades, refined department stores, orderly shop windows and warm architectural lighting. Maintain the same illustrated style and sunset atmosphere.

Introduce the new architecture building by building. Preserve existing landmarks until they naturally leave the view. Maintain the same sunset, exposure, travel speed and depth relationships. The interior lighting stays steady.

End with the new district becoming established outside, while the train continues moving.

corrected_pickup_prompt.text: Continue directly from the selected second clip with the same fixed camera. TABI slowly reaches for the existing tan takeaway cup with its dark lid and flower design, grips the cup body, and lifts it towards his chest. His other hand gently supports it. Preserve the cup's shape, lid and design. The open book and pen stay in place on the table; the brown bag stays on the seat. The current Ginza scenery keeps travelling right to left at the same speed. Gentle breathing and exterior motion continue through the final frame, with the cup comfortably held below his mouth.

Use one focused action per extension. Rest and pickup hand states are mutually exclusive; exterior district transitions are separate beats.
Measure decoded frames and timestamps on import; assemble native clips by parent order with continuous output timestamps rather than nominal Flow slots.
Review appearance separately from timing. Reject native prop invention before generating descendants.
